intro:
Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector O is commonly marketed as the Model Block and is one of the better-known developed or developing areas within Phase 2. Buyers searching this sector usually want its map position, plot sizes, current resale or booking availability, development status and price guidance.

Market listings may also use O1, O2 or O3 references. Always match the exact plot number and sub-area with the current map and documentation before comparing prices or making payment.
body:
## Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector O overview

Sector O is part of Faisal Town Phase 2 and is widely marketed as the Model Block.

Current property listings and project-focused market pages consistently use both “Sector O” and “Model Block” terminology, so buyers may encounter either name while searching for plots.

The sector is relevant to buyers looking for identifiable plot locations, active development, resale opportunities and comparatively clearer on-ground references than a general file-only search.

However, do not assume every Sector O listing has the same development, possession or payment status. Verify the exact plot and current documentation before making a decision.

## Sector O location and map

Sector O / Model Block is located within Faisal Town Phase 2 and is commonly associated with the development toward the Thalian Interchange side of the project.

Use the latest Faisal Town Phase 2 map to identify Sector O and then request the exact plot number and street location.

A sector-level map is useful for orientation, but it is not enough for a purchase decision.

For the individual property, confirm:

- exact plot number
- street or road
- O-sector sub-area
- plot dimensions
- corner or non-corner position
- main-road or internal location
- nearby development
- access from the main boulevard
- current physical condition of the site

A site visit is strongly recommended before paying a premium for a particular location.

## Why Sector O is called the Model Block

Sector O is commonly referred to in market material as the Model Block of Faisal Town Phase 2.

The “Model Block” label is generally used to distinguish this area as an early or showcase development within the larger Phase 2 project.

Because the term is used widely by dealers, property portals and project-focused websites, buyers searching “Faisal Town Phase 2 Model Block” will often find Sector O listings.

However, use the exact plot documentation rather than relying on the marketing label alone.

The Model Block name does not mean that every plot within Sector O has identical development, possession or transfer status.

## O1, O2 and O3 terminology

Some current Sector O listings use O1, O2 and O3 references.

These labels can help narrow the location, but buyers should not treat them as sufficient proof of a property's status.

If a seller mentions O1, O2 or O3, ask for:

- the exact plot number
- map position
- street or road reference
- current booking or transfer status
- outstanding dues
- development status
- possession status, where applicable

This is particularly important because market descriptions can sometimes use older or informal terminology.

For this reason, this website keeps Sector O as the main page rather than creating separate thin pages for O1, O2 and O3 without enough independently verified information.

## Plot sizes in Faisal Town Phase 2 Sector O

Current project-focused sources advertise several residential plot sizes in Sector O / Model Block.

Commonly marketed sizes include approximately:

- 5.56 marla
- 8 marla
- 10.89 marla
- 14.22 marla
- 1 kanal

The advertised dimensions associated with these sizes can differ from the rounded marla names commonly used by dealers.

Always verify the precise dimensions and area from the relevant plot documentation before comparing two properties.

A smaller plot with a stronger location may also command a higher asking price than a larger plot in a weaker street or development position.

## Sector O plots for sale

Sector O has active market inventory, including both plot and file-related listings.

Current listings may represent different situations, including:

- identified plots
- resale inventory
- paid or partially paid files
- developed or semi-developed locations
- properties with different dues positions

For this reason, two advertisements using the same plot size should not automatically be compared as equivalent.

Before considering an asking price, determine exactly what is being sold.

Confirm whether the seller is offering:

- an allocated plot
- a transferable file
- a plot with a confirmed number
- fully paid inventory
- inventory with outstanding dues
- possession or non-possession property

The financial comparison only becomes meaningful after those differences are understood.

## Sector O prices

There is no single reliable price for every Sector O plot.

Current asking prices can vary depending on:

- plot size
- exact O-sector location
- O1, O2 or O3 reference
- street and road width
- corner position
- main-road location
- park-facing or other special position
- development status
- possession status
- outstanding dues
- payment completion
- seller urgency
- current market demand

When comparing prices, try to compare properties with the same plot size, similar payment status and similar physical location.

Do not use an old payment plan as the current resale value.

The resale market can move independently from the original booking price.

## Sector O payment-plan checks

Payment terms in Sector O should be checked for the exact property being offered.

A resale plot, fully paid file and fresh-booking inventory may all have different financial structures.

Before paying anything, request a written breakdown showing:

- agreed sale price
- amount already paid
- remaining installments, if any
- outstanding development charges
- transfer charges
- membership or processing charges
- location premium
- taxes and other transaction costs

This gives you the real total acquisition cost rather than only the advertised price.

Avoid assuming Sector O follows the same payment plan as Sector P, R, T or another Phase 2 area.

## Sector O development and possession

Sector O is frequently marketed as one of the more actively developed areas of Faisal Town Phase 2.

Recent property listings also describe ongoing development work and distinguish between different O-sector sub-areas. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

However, development and possession should be verified for the exact plot rather than inferred from the sector name.

During a site visit, look for:

- road formation or carpeting
- sewerage or drainage work
- electricity infrastructure
- street demarcation
- plot marking
- surrounding construction
- access roads
- machinery or active development
- possession activity, where applicable

If a dealer claims that possession is available or imminent, ask for current written confirmation relevant to the exact property.

## Who Sector O may suit

Sector O may suit buyers who want a Phase 2 location with a clearer physical reference and active market inventory.

It may be particularly relevant to buyers who prefer to evaluate a specific numbered plot rather than purchasing only a general project file.

For an end-user, development progress, access and possession timing may matter more than short-term resale activity.

For an investor, entry price, dues position, exact location and likely future demand may carry more weight.

The best choice therefore depends on whether you intend to build, hold or resell.

## Is Sector O good for investment?

Sector O can be considered as part of a broader Faisal Town Phase 2 investment comparison, but investment quality depends on the individual property and purchase price.

Do not buy only because the plot is labelled “Model Block.”

Compare:

- the exact plot position
- current development
- total payable amount
- dues status
- resale demand
- competing listings
- road and location premium
- transfer readiness
- expected holding period

A well-located property purchased at a reasonable total cost may be more attractive than a heavily premium-priced plot with similar fundamentals.

No future price appreciation should be treated as guaranteed.

## Sector O site-visit checklist

Before making an offer, visit the actual location where possible.

Check:

- plot number
- exact O-sector sub-area
- map position
- street width
- main access
- road condition
- nearby plots and construction
- commercial or community areas
- drainage and site level
- corner or special-location status
- physical development around the plot

Take the map or plot reference with you so the location shown by the seller can be matched with the paperwork.

If the plot cannot be identified confidently on the ground, resolve that issue before making payment.

## Sector O vs other Faisal Town Phase 2 sectors

Do not choose Sector O simply because it is known as the Model Block.

Compare it with the other Phase 2 sectors relevant to your budget, including Sector P, Sector R, Sector T and the Overseas area where appropriate.

Consider:

- current asking price
- plot size
- development progress
- access
- payment status
- resale supply
- possession expectations
- total acquisition cost

Sector O may offer a stronger fit for one buyer while another Phase 2 sector may provide better value for someone with a different budget or time horizon.

## Do not confuse Sector O with Phase 1 Block O

Sector O on this page refers specifically to Faisal Town Phase 2.

It should not be mixed with Phase 1 block terminology or with unrelated Block A, Block B or Block C pages.

Whenever a listing uses only “O Block” without mentioning the phase, ask the seller to confirm:

- Faisal Town Phase 1 or Phase 2
- exact sector or block
- plot number
- map reference

This small verification step can prevent comparisons between entirely different locations.
